integrity: Analytic derivation, uniqueness and moments proof plus a standalone exact symbolic and seeded simulation checker; no external certification.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional harmonic potential, a single rRKN 2.5 substep with full independent Gaussian momentum refresh, and unadjusted position marginal; larger calibration lies outside original small-step accuracy theorem. No general diffusion or multidimensional result. Publication-priority risk remains.
title: Two exact temperature-calibration steps and a fourth-moment trap in randomized Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
